item.subject: science
item.stem: A large forest area near Meena's village is cut down to build a road. Which statement about the effects on soil and living conditions is NOT correct?

options.A: The soil is held firmly by the remaining roots, so it cannot be washed away.
options.B: Rainwater can wash away the topsoil because fewer roots hold it.
options.C: Less leaf fall and decomposition reduce the quality of the soil.
options.D: Animals and birds lose food and shelter and must leave the area.
